module load openmpi/gcc/3.1.3/64
#module load fftw

    flux submit --depend=afterany:$FLUX_JOB_ID run.sample.qs

    flux mini run -n 4 /home/tgartner/Software-deepmd-kit-1.0/lammps-3Mar20/src/lmp_mpi -i in.lammps.sample -e screen
